senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (मखति) also (इ) मखि (मङ्खति)
To go, to move.

m. (-खः)
Sacrifice, oblation.
E.
मख to go, aff. घञ् or घ.

m. (-ता)
RĀMA, the son of DAŚARATHA, and second incarnation of VIṢṆU so named.
E.
मख sacrifice, and त्रातृ who preserves; his first exploit being the discomfiture of the Rākṣasas, who disturbed the sacrifices of VIŚVAMITRA.

m. (-ह्निः)
Sacrificial fire.
E.
मख sacrifice, and वह्नि fire; also similar compounds, as मखाग्नि, &c.

m. (-लः)
Sacrificial fire.
E.
मख, and अनल fire.

m. (-ट्)
ŚIVA.
E.
मख sacrifice, here meaning the sacrifice offered by DAKṢA, and असुहृद् unfriendly; having disturbed the ceremony, and slain the sacrificer.
